answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because zephyr only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, kernel is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any bridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
